part.text:
Done. Summary:

## Root cause
`createSlot`'s render called the plain `composeRefs(forwardedRef, slottableElementRef)` (packages/react/slot/src/slot.tsx:75), creating a **new ref-callback identity on every render** — every other Radix component uses the memoized `useComposedRefs`. React re-invokes (detach + reattach) callback refs whenever their identity changes; on React 19 that happens on every update. When the composed chain includes a ref callback that triggers a state update (Slate/Plate register editor nodes this way), each re-invocation schedules another render, which yields another new identity, re-invoking the refs again → `Maximum update depth exceeded`. The non-looping symptom (ref called on every keystroke) and the loop itself both trace to this one un-memoized call site.

## Changes
- `packages/react/slot/src/slot.tsx` — use `useComposedRefs` (memoized, stable identity while the input refs are stable) and hoist it **above the empty-children early return** so hook order stays stable when children toggle between slottable and empty. `slottableElementRef` is computed as `undefined` on the early-return path.
- `packages/react/slot/src/slot.test.tsx` — un-skipped the `given an Input` regression (function ref expected to be called once while typing) and added a `CountingInput` test whose child ref callback calls `setState` on each invocation — the exact pattern from the bug report.

## Verification
- **Pre-fix (fix stashed):** both regression tests fail deterministically — the count test with 7 calls instead of 1, and the new test throwing the verbatim reported error: `Error: Maximum update depth exceeded...`
- **Post-fix:** `pnpm vitest run packages/react/slot` → 32/32 passed; full monorepo `pnpm vitest run` → 20 files, **258 passed, 1 todo, 0 failed**; `tsc --noEmit` and `oxlint` clean on the slot package.
- A snapshot file that vitest rewrote with line-ending-only changes was restored; the final diff touches only the two files above.
